name: Power Ring
lore: From the old kingdom's champions, a signet whose grip closes on its own.

name: Magic Ring
lore: Court-circle work; it hums near a sentence left unfinished.

name: Speed Ring
lore: Won at a duel the witnesses called mercifully short.

name: Shield Ring
lore: Cast from a shield-boss that outlived the three men who carried it.

name: Barrier Ring
lore: A seer's ward against sorcery, etched in patient script.

name: Skill Ring
lore: The drillmaster's parting gift, still sharpening hands he never met.

name: Goddess Icon
lore: A pocket shrine worn smooth by one thumb's worth of prayer.

name: Seraph Robe
lore: Temple weave that lies heavy as a hand and steadies the heart under it.

name: Boots
lore: They still take the shortcuts their dead courier never named.

name: Delphi Shield
lore: A sky-knight's talisman that tells the arrow it has no special claim.

name: Veteran's Crest
lore: Given after a soldier's twentieth battle; almost none change hands.

name: Wrath Band
lore: An arm-ring of the berserk school, awake only once the wearer bleeds.

name: Counter Seal
lore: Wear the duelist's mark and you are owed a blow for every blow.

name: Pursuit Ring
lore: An old-kingdom hunting band; the quarry is always slower than it hopes.

name: Nullify Ring
lore: Every slayer-rune, etched and then struck through.

name: Life Ring
lore: Favors the wearer who hasn't yet been touched.

name: Forest Charm
lore: Braided from border-wood; under the trees, the wearer counts as one of them.

name: Blood Gem
lore: A dark stone that covers part of every art's blood-price.

name: Vampire's Bloodshard
lore: Splinter of a thing the seers burned; it feeds the wearer what the blade spills.

name: Soothing Stone
lore: River-smooth and always warm; wounds ease a little near it each morning.

name: Phoenix Brooch
lore: Ash-forged, and stubborn about letting its wearer fall.

name: Recoil Guard
lore: Smith-blessed bracing that stiffens the body right after the art lands.

name: Bounty Hunter's Mark
lore: A guild tally-brand; every notch is worth coin to someone.

name: Moontide Amulet
lore: Tide-silver, strong and weak by a calendar no one has finished reading.

name: Gambler's Coin
lore: Two faces, neither honest; flip it and take what you're given.

name: Vanguard Crest
lore: The lone-spear medal, struck for ground no one else came to hold.

name: Diamond Medallion
lore: Cut to break up whatever crowds in; caravan guards swear by it.

name: Hunter's Cloak
lore: Oiled against weather and cut to vanish; in wild country it is armor.

name: Duelist's Glove
lore: One wearer, one opponent, no help -- the way it likes a fight.

name: Warding Charm
lore: A seer's finished ward; curses arrive, find nothing to hold, and pass on.
